newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares weaker but above early lows.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares weaker but above early lows.

text.p: Austrian shares closed the first day of trading in the New Year on a weaker note, weighed down by Tuesday's losses on Wall Street and declines on Europe's main markets, but managed to sneak up from earlier lows.

The ATX index of 21 shares fell 5.32 points or 0.47 percent to close at 1,134.87, above a low of 1,125.06 points seen in early trade. Among its constituents, 13 shares fell, six rose and two remained unchanged.
Traders said the market was still in holiday mode and there was little hope that activity would pick up before Monday. "There was very little action," said one. "People are still on holidays."
Depending on the international environment, the ATX index should remain trapped in a narrow range between 1,120 and 1,140 points, market participants said.
Airport operator Flughafen Wien led the day's decliners, falling 2.54 percent to close at 538 schillings. Brewery group Brau Union topped the day's winners, rising 2.56 percent to 686 schillings.
Financial stocks were weaker as investors held out for new developments in the seemingly endless privatisation saga of Creditanstalt, the country's flagship bank.

Tensions have risen over the past weeks after Bank Austria entered the race with a last-minute bid for the government's 70 percent stake in the bank, rivalling an existing offer by a group led by insurer EA-Generali and a bid by Karl Wlaschek, an Austrian entrepreneur.
The finance ministry on Monday gave bidders a final deadline to January 10 to top up their offers.

Creditanstalt's common stock was down five schillings at 728, while the bank's preference shares fell 14 schillings to 486. Bank Austria preferred eased four schillings to 416, and EA-Generali shed 60 schillings to 3,140.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index fell 2.74 points or 0.64 percent to 426.46.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX contracts for January delivery weakened 13 points to 1,135.0.
